whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `[patch.crates-io]` section that swaps a published crate.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a `[patch.crates-io]` section that swaps a published crate.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Cargo.toml no longer carries a `[patch.crates-io]` section that swaps a published crate.
